Plain clause + のももっともだ
If no one had told her anything, it is understandable that she was surprised.
After waiting three hours, it is understandable that he is angry.
For a first trip abroad, feeling anxious is perfectly understandable.
formation: Plain clause + のももっともだ
restrictions: もっとも evaluates a response as reasonable under the circumstances.
mistake: It does not necessarily endorse every action caused by the feeling.

segments.role: Recognize someone’s reaction as understandable. Plain clause + のももっともだ
